posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
The question is correct.

Remember we are following gawk in our syllabus. You are using nawk or some other alternatives instead in your local VM. I would recommend you to either use our System Commands cloud VM for practising, or to download and use the GNU coreutils. Your gawk might be saved in your system under the binary name of gawk instead.

Screenshot 2024-11-25 at 10.23.37 AM1880×250 170 KB

FIELDWIDTHS is a gawk feature, and thus will obviously not work without gawk.

Screenshot 2024-11-25 at 10.27.46 AM1886×422 27.3 KB

reference

This is also mentioned in the Navigating Linux textbook in page 480.

Screenshot 2024-11-25 at 10.28.54 AM974×498 45.2 KB
